intended_object: An intermediate expression in the Krause–Lacey bad-scale estimate inside the quadratic Carleson proof: a finite sum over parent intervals of localized pieces, each applied to a regrouped parent input. Its docstring calls it "the source sum after its finite regrouping by parent intervals".
explanation: This is a helper term built for one step of a proof. Its body is a finite sum, over the intervals in `R.biUnion N`, of `krauseLaceyLocalizedPiece 1 (j - 2) I` applied to `energyStandardSourceParentInput S f I₀ k₀ scale R N I`. It exists only so the library can name the regrouped sum and prove an L∞ bound for it (`norm_energyStandardRegroupedSourceAction_le`). The literature has no standard object it is meant to match, so it cannot be checked for faithfulness to a textbook definition.
